Mountain Play Lodge

3389 Sweeten Creek Rd.Arden, NC 28704
Phone: 828.676.2120
Business Hours: M-Th 9am-12pm, F 9am-3pm, Sat and Sunday 12pm-6pmEmail: info@mountainplaylodge.comWebsite: Visit Website Google Map

This large indoor playground is great for those summer storm days or when you want to beat the heat. Kids will remember life-sized playsets.

Mountain Play Lodge offers open play day admission for children ages 12 & younger. We do not charge for adults. WE DO NOT PERMIT OUTSIDE FOOD/DRINK IN OUR FACILITY. IF YOU BRING IT IN, YOU WILL BE ASKED TO DISCARD OR LEAVE WITHOUT REFUND. DON'T FORGET YOUR SOCKS..everyone, including adults, must wear socks on our play floor!

Open Play Admission 3-12 years
.........................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................
$15
Open play admission is an All-Day Admission. Admission is valid during business hours on day of purchase. Adults are free!

Open Play Admission Ages 2 & Under
.........................................................................................................................................................................................................................................................
$10
Open Play Admission for ages 2 & Younger is an All Day Admission. Children that have not celebrated their 1st birthday are charged unless accompanied by a paid sibling. Admission is valid during business hours on day of purchase.

Bricks 4 Kidz

954 Tunnel Road Asheville, NC 28805
Phone: (828)674-2446Email: asmith@bricks4kidz.comWebsite: Visit Website

Image Credit: Bricks 4 Kidz

*Availability: As of June 1st, a few spots remain in some weeks offered! Scroll down to see which weeks are full and which ones still have availability.

Bricks 4 Kidz offers half-day (morning or afternoon) and full-day camps for kids (ages 4+) running from June 12th through to August 25th.

Does your child enjoy building with LEGO® bricks? Through these amazing summer camps, they can experience hands-on engineering fundamentals as they build motorized models that introduce them to engineering, architecture, and scientific principles while developing problem solving and critical thinking skills.

Themes:

Junior Builders (ages 4-6) - only 5 spots remain for July 5th - 7th (afternoon)
Builders will engage in a group build each day, learn about designing with LEGO® Mosaics and 3D Color Kit LEGOs®, and problem solve through unique challenges.

Minecraft Masters (ages 5+) - full, waitlist only
With brand new builds, campers will delve deep into the world of Minecraft with Ender Dragons, Steve, Zombie Pigman, TNT, Creepers, and Endermens. Campers will face new challenges each day, building LEGO® motorized robotic models and crafting key elements from the popular Minecraft game!

Week at the Museum Camp (ages 5+) - 8 spots remain for June 26th - 30th (afternoon)
Let Bricks 4 Kidz bring your favorite bits of history to life in our very first Week At The Museum LEGO® Camp, based on the popular Night At The Museum movie series! Explore history in this LEGO® exhibition that will see your child become an adventurous archeologist, uncovering the wonders of the world with Indiana Jones and other famous explorers, discovering renowned artifacts from the dinosaurs and caveman of the pre-historic era, pharaohs and mummies from ancient Egypt, Atilla the Hun, Lewis and Clark, Cowboys and Indians, and much more!

Ninja-GO (ages 5+) - full, waitlist only
Join the team by using Lego bricks, gears and motors to build awesome Ninjago themed models. Ninja battles, crafts and more await you in this camp!

Jurassic Brick Land/Dinosaurs (ages 5+) - 10 spots remain for July 24-28 (afternoon)
Campers will build dinosaurs out of Lego bricks like the Brontosaurus, T-Rex and Velociraptor! We will learn about these amazing creatures that lived during the Jurassic period. Expect lots of dinosaur themed fun at this camp!

Brick City Builders (ages 5+) - 5 spots remain for June 12th - 16th (afternoon)
There are many different types of engineering jobs, and building is one of the most fun! What would a city be without the architects and engineers who come up with the ideas, plans and building skills to make it all come together? Campers will put their engineering and architecture skills to work as they build city themed models using LEGO® Bricks.

Superhero Academy (ages 5+) - 2 spots remain for August 7th - 11th (morning)
Join us for a week of Superhero fun using Lego bricks and motors! Explore all the caped crusaders and discover their super powers. Expect lots of motorized Lego builds, plus SUPER crafts and games!

Star War Adventures (ages 5+) - 10 spots remain for August 21st - 25th (afternoon)
Inspired by NASA and Star Wars®, our Star Wars Camp is packed full of MOTORIZED models that will make your imagination blast off! Each day, campers will learn about real-life space exploration and build models related to the NASA space program. In addition, the day includes B4K designed models, LEGO® Star Wars® themed sets , group games, challenges and more.

Pokemon Party (ages 5+) - full, waitlist only
Capture wild Pokémon creatures and train them for battle. Improve your accuracy and power as you learn new moves and use special abilities. Tap into your inner engineer as we build Dratini, Pikachu, Poké Balls, and more. Bring your own Pokémon trading cards if you wish to play and trade at the end of each day.

Bricks 4 Chicks (ages 5+) - 11 spots remain for July 17th - 21st (morning)
Did you know we offer a GIRLS ONLY Lego camp this summer? It’s called Bricks 4 Chicks and it is so much fun! Girls will not only play and build with girl based Lego Friends sets and other STEM based materials, but they will also learn about making and keeping friends, self esteem, anti bullying and much more!

A Pirate's Life for Me (ages 5+) - 13 spots remain for July 17th - 21st (afternoon)
Shiver me timbers as we explore the popular culture behind the life of a pirate. Build a motorized pirate ship, a capstan, a helm and an anchor, as we batten down the hatches and prepare for mutiny. Protect the hands on deck by building a launching trebuchet.

Lego Mash-Up Camp (ages 5+) - 7 spots remain for August 21st - 25th (morning)
Bricks 4 Kidz has added a whole new curriculum complete with all of your favorite themes plus Super Mario Bros, Roblox, Harry Potter, Super Smash Brothers, LEGO® Movie, and more! You don’t want to miss the best mash up there is with a new theme each day!

Mystery Mix Up (ages 5+) - 4 spots remain for July 10th - 14th (afternoon)
Whodunnit!? Join us for this real life Mystery Mix using our best skills from CLUE to Scooby Do! Each day, campers will go on an adventure to solve a mystery. We introduce new challenges and new ways to deduct the “who”, “how”, and “why”. Along the way, campers will build a variety of different LEGO models and problem solve with gizmos and gears. Activities will include scavenger hunts, clue analyzing, and much more!

Junior Robotics using Lego WeDo 2.0 (ages 7+) - full, waitlist only
How would you like to turn your next LEGO creation into a robot, programmed to do exactly what you tell it to do? The Bricks 4 Kidz Junior Robotics camp offers all the fun of building with LEGO bricks, plus the challenge of junior computer programming! Using drag-and-drop icon-based software, WeDo 2.0 software provides an introduction into the world of computer-programming and robotics that will equip children to succeed in a technology-based marketplace.

Click here to read more information and to register.

Asheville Youth Sailing

600 Julian LnArden, NC 28704
Phone: (828) 229-5511Email: info@ashevilleyouthsailing.orgWebsite: Visit Website

Image Credit: Asheville Youth Sailing

*Availability: Morning camps are full; however, a few spots remain for the afternoon sessions. Additionally, some scholarships remain as well. Click here to apply.

With morning and afternoon sessions running June 12th - July 7th, Asheville Youth Sailing offers aspiring sailors (ages 5-18) a chance to get out on the water and have fun.

Start Off Sailing: ages 5 - 7
June 12-15 and June 19-22 from 9:30 AM - 11:30 AM

Sailors will be paired two to a boat with an emphasis on safety, having fun, and learning the basics of sailing.

Beginner Opti Sailing: ages 8 - 9
June 12-15 and June 19-22 from 9:30 AM - 11:30 AM

Sailors will learn to sail Optimist Dinghy trainers that are designed to be sailed single-handed.

Junior Sailing: ages 9 - 16
June 12-16 and June 19-23 from 1 PM - 5 PM

These sessions will be geared towards different sailing ability and interest of the students.

Junior Open Sailing: ages 9 - 18
June 26-30 and July 3-7 from 1 PM - 5 PM

These sessions are for sailors who have previously sailed with Asheville Youth Sailing to practice and enhance their skills. Sailors will soak up the sunshine, play safe games, do drills and races, and simply enjoy sailing around.

Click here to register and read more details.
